mira_devx: Running into a crash in the async Python SDK when the server returns application/problem+json. client.complete_chat(...) bubbles up aiohttp.ContentTypeError instead of a friendly API error.

igor_sdk: can you paste the exact traceback + response headers?

mira_devx: traceback snippet:
```
File "/workspace/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood_sdk/async_client.py", line 230, in _handle_resp
    body = await resp.json()
aiohttp.ContentTypeError: 0, message='Attempt to decode JSON with unexpected mimetype'
```
headers: `{'content-type': 'application/problem+json; charset=utf-8', 'x-request-id': 'req_prod_456'}`

ralph_be: aiohttp enforces Content-Type strictly so application/problem+json variants can raise even if body is valid JSON. We should not let ContentTypeError escape to user code.

igor_sdk: quick fix: try resp.json(content_type=None) or wrap resp.json() in try/except ContentTypeError and fallback to resp.text() then json.loads. Attach both parsed payload and raw_text to the raised exception so callers can inspect either.

mira_devx: yes — right now our ApiError only has message + code. I ended up parsing raw bytes in my service which is annoying. If we add `.payload` (optional dict) and `.raw_text` (optional str) that'd be ideal.

ralph_be: long-term: define typed exceptions in the public API: RedwoodError -> RedwoodHTTPError(status, payload, raw_text), RedwoodValidationError(payload), RedwoodRateLimitError(retry_after). Also add `.is_retryable` property where appropriate (5xx, 429).

igor_sdk: will add a small helper parse_problem_details(text) that canonicalizes title/detail/invalid-params to a typed dataclass for stubs. Also include unit tests for headers like `application/problem+json; charset=utf-8` and `text/plain`.

mira_devx: can you also add a tiny docs snippet showing how to log useful info: `except RedwoodHTTPError as e: logger.info(e.payload or e.raw_text)` so people stop logging str(e) which is almost always unhelpful.

igor_sdk: opening GH issue now and starting branch `fix/python-exc-body-fallback`. tagging with `sdk-python`, `errors`, `dx`. Patch will target 0.23.x.

ci-bot: CI: test-suite for branch fix/python-exc-body-fallback passed (pipeline #984) :white_check_mark:

mira_devx: thanks — this will unblock partners sending RFC7807 validation errors. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
